name: Seletar Airport

curfew.v: No flights 22:00–07:00 Singapore time (14:00–23:00 UTC), except medical evacuation and emergency flights

customs.v: Customs and immigration open 24 hours; non-scheduled flights clear at the Seletar Business Aviation Centre

max_aircraft.v: Largest stands take up to a Boeing 757-200 without winglets

handling.v: Every arriving and departing aircraft must appoint a licensed ground handling agent

noise.v: Subsonic jets need a noise certificate to ICAO Annex 16, Volume I, Chapter 3 or equivalent

fuel.v: 07:30–22:00 Monday to Friday; 08:30–17:30 weekends and public holidays (Singapore time)

notes: Slot rules for Seletar are in Singapore AIP GEN 1.2, not read yet.
